metadata.description: Landflow Ops & SOC: alert triage, Landfall war rooms and threat intel, as node plugins with ready-made flows.

plugins.name: triage
plugins.description: Alert triage that decides whether an alert deserves a war room: normalize Alertmanager, Grafana, Datadog, CloudWatch, Sentry and Wazuh alerts, extract IOCs, parse reported emails, rules people approve, and a fail-open triage decision. Flows: alert and phishing triage into Landfall, and a daily digest.

plugins.name: landfall
plugins.description: Landfall nodes: open, attach and recover incidents from alerts, declare rooms, read and add to timelines, record fixes applied outside Landfall, heartbeats, and a trigger for opened and ended rooms. Flows: workflow failures and a heartbeat into Landfall, and lessons from closed rooms.

plugins.name: threat-intel
plugins.description: Read-only threat intel in Go: VirusTotal, AbuseIPDB, GreyNoise, urlscan.io, Shodan, AlienVault OTX and MISP, plus IOC Enrich, which asks all of them at once with a cache and one verdict. Flow: an IOC lookup API.
